guard: every P7 kind reaches its per-space location through ONE migrating choke point; the owners that must not migrate address the same layout it does; and `space rm`'s reap takes exactly one tenant's material, past the point of no return, without ever refusing
why: All five segmented kinds have an absent-means-MINT writer. That makes the read-fallback the
obvious-looking implementation - resolve the canonical location, fall back to the flat one -
into the worst one available: on a root whose material has not moved yet, the canonical read
answers ABSENT and the writer mints a SECOND live credential beside the one the running daemons
hold. Nothing errors. The split shows up later as a daemon the broker refuses, on a root where
both files look valid. So the property is not `the key is right`; it is `the move happened
before anyone could read absence`, which is why the migration lives inside the resolver rather
than beside it, and why the refusals must travel OUT through the resolver instead of being
caught there. The fourth mutation guards the other end: the hosted arm must not answer with the
pre-P7 flat kind, because a host provisions from the key this returns.
The reap mutations (5-9) all turn on WHERE in the `space rm` sequence a step runs. Step 7 is
past step 5's point of no return, so the reap's contract is the inverse of the resolver's: it
must not migrate, must not refuse, and must not throw - a throw there strands the journal entry
and recurs identically on every re-run, so the removal a crash is supposed to be able to finish
could never finish at all. It is also the only sweep in the codebase that runs on a root OTHER
TENANTS ARE STILL USING, which is why the `.cotal/space.*` spelling - the one a reader reaches
for after seeing a directory removal - is graded here: it passes every removal cell while taking
every survivor's live material and reporting success. Mutation 9 is the door defect this commit
found and fixed, restored as it stood: a remedy asserted rather than asked, which prints a
command that refuses on exactly the roots the door was written for.
